description: Au-197(n,g)Au-198 (2.6947 d) -> stable Hg-198; N pulses of 1 ns (flux 1e20 n/cm2/s during the pulse, sigma 98.65 b -> 1e-11 captures per atom per pulse), period 0.1 s. Reference by exact period-propagator powers; per-step values only for the 1e4 case.

pulse_train.note: ACTINV needs 2*n_pulses explicit schedule steps (on, off, on, off, ...)

periodic_steady_state.formula: A_ss(end of pulse) = R (1 - exp(-lam t_on)) / (1 - exp(-lam T)), R = N(Au197) * sigma*phi*1e-24 (undepleted)

conventions.precision: mpmath scaling-and-squaring Taylor expm; per-case working precision of 120 to 500 digits, cross-checked at twice that (precision_cross_check_max_rel_diff); output 30 significant digits

reference_steps_note: every step of the first 10 pulses, end of pulse and end of period of every 100th pulse, and the final step; values from plain stepping
